about: Blue Star Limited provides air conditioning and commercial refrigeration products, air and water purifiers, air coolers, cold storages, and specialty products in India. It operates through three segments: Electro-Mechanical Projects and Commercial Air Conditioning Systems; Unitary Products; and Professional Electronics and Industrial Systems.
